source_hypothesis: Lan et al. (2024), A-share post-earnings-announcement drift; local adaptation, not paper replication
historical_universe: point-in-time CSI500 main-board constituent on the signal day
event: one unambiguous original annual, Q1, half-year, or Q3 report per company and fiscal year
availability: announcement timestamp treated as date-only; visible after announcement-day close
signal: next trading session opening price / previous trading session close - 1
entry: close of the trading session after the opening-response observation
comparison: event stock adjusted-close return minus CSI500 adjusted-close return minus 0.002 round-trip cost
claim_boundary: signal diagnostic only; no investable portfolio, annual return, or 2026 validation claim
